prerequisites: Knowledge across the breadth of the studied field.

learning_outcomes.text: Students methodically and structurally process technical and/or scientific tasks within a given timeframe. They classify the results into an application-oriented context.
Students independently delve into a new practice-oriented task within a limited time. They deepen knowledge in a specific area on a scientific basis, depending on the task.

Students evaluate existing approaches and concepts based on a concrete scientific or technical task. They assess their applicability for the specific task and evaluate them. They synthesize their own results and verify them in relation to the task.

Students create and use tools and methods to support their work. They independently acquire new knowledge related to the task and apply it to solve the task. They develop and apply subject-specific abilities, skills, and techniques to independently solve practical professional tasks.
Students critically analyze existing solutions and their own results and present them in an overall context. They design task-related research questions and use them to select their methods.

Students present the achieved results in a scientific form in working groups. They demonstrate achieved solutions and exchange ideas with other students and lecturers. They cooperate within and beyond project groups.

syllabus_topics: Independent processing of a practical project in individual or group work as a subtask within a working group
Preparation of a project report on a scientific basis
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a project report (written) with a length of 40-80 pages.
